Description: In a pre-dawn Attic conversation, Tony Dauer panics over his missing handgun and asks Annie Beaumont for help. They discuss the missing gun, a door that was locked but somehow opened, disappearing corpses, and the possibility of “ghosts.” After hearing Victoria Maseko call out, they leave together.
Location: Attic（Attic）
Key Information:
  - Before dawn, Tony Dauer comes to the Attic, knocks to wake Annie Beaumont, and asks to enter the room.
  - Tony Dauer says his police revolver went missing overnight, even though he is certain he locked his door before sleeping.
  - Tony Dauer finds that the lock is in an open state when he wakes up, occurring alongside the gun’s disappearance, which makes him extremely uneasy.
  - Annie Beaumont questions whether Tony still had the gun before sleep and points out how abnormal it is that a locked door failed.
  - Tony Dauer says he hardly knows anyone else in the villa, so he can only ask Annie Beaumont for help.
  - They discuss whether the missing gun is connected to the continual appearance of corpses.
  - Annie Beaumont mentions that there was a previous case of a “corpse disappearing,” strengthening the sense of an ongoing abnormal pattern.
  - Annie Beaumont relays Oswald’s claim: these corpses may all be people who lived in the villa in the past.
  - They question the villa’s actual headcount and the scale of what is happening, and briefly discuss the possibility of “ghosts or spirits.”
  - Annie Beaumont brings up Tony Dauer’s earlier rumor about “the girl who used to live in the Attic,” calling it the only clue they have at present.
  - Tony Dauer hesitates about continuing the investigation, but does not explicitly refuse under Annie Beaumont’s insistence.
  - They then hear Victoria Maseko shouting and immediately rush out of the Attic to check what is happening.
Characters:
  [Annie Beaumont（Annie Beaumont）] Person No. 2.
    · Is woken in the Attic by Tony Dauer and speaks with him.
    · Challenges the missing gun and the failure of a locked door.
    · Raises discussion about disappearing corpses and the possibility of ghosts.
    · Suggests investigating the girl who used to live in the Attic as a lead.
    · Moves immediately upon hearing Victoria Maseko’s shout.
  [Tony Dauer（Tony Dauer）] Person No. 4, Helen Dauer’s son.
    · Panics because his police revolver disappeared overnight.
    · Confirms he locked his door before sleeping, but the lock was open when he woke.
    · Believes Annie Beaumont is the only person in the villa he can trust.
    · Suspects the incident might involve ghosts.
    · Reluctantly participates in further investigation at Annie Beaumont’s suggestion.
